title: Advancing Responsible Innovation in Agentic AI: A study of Ethical Frameworks for Household Automation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis and literature review of the ethical challenges, privacy risks, and autonomy issues faced by elderly individuals and children interacting with agentic AI in smart home environments.
Qualitative analysis and conceptual review of systemic biases, neurotypical design assumptions, and communication barriers in AI models that negatively affect neurodivergent users.
